en: The postcard shows an early 20th-century colorized photograph of a European city park and prominent buildings, with ornate architecture. In the foreground, you see a tree-lined boulevard, benches, and greenery. The text identifies the place as 'Sundsvall'. The reverse side features handwritten Swedish text and an old Swedish stamp, with a date stamp from 1905. The recipient's address is in Östersund.
